default/30674.htm.text: Daurin Hammercrush: Do you have something for me? If not, please leave, I'm busy.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30674-01.html.text: Daurin Hammercrush: Hey, are you the one I am supposed to meet here? Have you heard? Leto Lizardmen are hiding in that house over there! Being alone, I couldn't take any action, I had to just follow them here.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30674-02a.html.text: Daurin Hammercrush: What are you waiting for?! Catch them before they get away.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30674-03.html.text: Daurin Hammercrush: Hmm...what does this say? 'Perform the ritual at the Obelisk of Shilen'.. I think they took the girl to the obelisk in the Dark Forest. Then the Dark Elves are involved in this case? Curse them! There are many obelisks in the Dark Forest... We can't figure out which obelisk they…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30674-04.html.text: Daurin Hammercrush: Hey, what are you waiting for? The victim is a young girl! What if the Dark Elves do something unspeakable to her? You must find her quickly! They must have taken her to a place like an altar...

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30674-02.html.text: Daurin Hammercrush: Those damn Leto Lizardmen ! They must've been expecting us! Attack!
